notes.title: A letter to [Muse Dash] fans

To our lovely friends:
Thanks y’all for supporting [Muse Dash] and helping us grow over the years! Due to the extremely modest price point of [Just as Planned], our company has undergone colossal financial losses, making it impossible for us to feed our devs and continue to update [Just as Planned]. We are preparing to file for bankruptcy in the following days.
For anyone who hasn’t gotten their hands on Muse Dash, we liquidated all our assets to bring to you one last discount event: starting from Mar 30th through  April 7th, the base game will be 70% off, and Just As Planned 20% off. You won’t be hearing from us anymore after this.

[Muse Dash] dev team: PeroPeroGames
Apr 1st, 2021

notes.title: Spread the words!! PC and Switch gamers are finally getting Muse Dash!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Muse Dash, the rhythm action title from PeroPeroGames, is coming to Steam in the middle of June! Muse Dash will finally hit both platforms with a limited-time exclusive Marija skin on PC. Check out the new announcement trailer we made:

https://youtu.be/mJtKtZk2C0U

Given the Players’ Choice award by TapTap and best indie game of 2018 awards from other platforms with honorable mention from Nintendo Direct Japan, Muse Dash has secured a special spot in many players’ hearts, and now the waifus are here to collect yours too.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31923494/7282ad6ec91bce45cdb8766fcdc7bd2290d0e50f.jpg[/img]

Simple 2-button controls make Muse Dash easy for players to jump into, with action side-scroller mechanics like traditional rhythm game instrument solos, timed dodges, and beat-based enemy attacks all mixed together to mash the perfect jam. Rhythm game players will also find depth in Muse Dash, as mastering each song takes more than just a few tries. Each song comes with trophies to unlock, leaderboards to make your mark on, and 3 difficulties to suit your style.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31923494/aecfd130ce65c55f621481f6748a6cadb4731f5f.jpg[/img]

The PC and Nintendo Switch versions of Muse Dash will include English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and traditional Chinese localization options for players to choose from. The Nintendo Switch version will launch on the e-shop in Japan, North America, Europe, and Australia with DLC included, while the PC release will be worldwide with DLC available separately.

Find out more info at [url=https://twitter.com/XDNetworkTwi]X.D Network on Twitter[/url]. And don’t forget to wishlist Muse Dash on Steam!
